_comment: TERRAIN-MATERIAL-TEXTURE-REMAP-1 prep. Data-driven layer -> source-pack -> cooked-map mapping. Consumed by cook_terrain_layers.py. Source packs live under C:/Users/Joe/Downloads/GameAsset/Terrain (AmbientCG + PolyHaven, alpine-biased picks). Output size is fixed at 2048 (engine requires all mat<N>_normal array layers share one square arrayWidth, terrtxm2.cpp:2491-2492). rough/ao are NOT cooked in this pass (scalars-v2 ruling: data/terrain_materials.json *_roughness / *_ao keys stay authoritative) -- fields are recorded per-entry for provenance/future-ORM only.
packing_convention: normal.ktx2 is BC7 linear RGBA: rgb=tangent-space normal (NormalGL/nor_gl convention, matches existing matNormalArray .rgb), a=height/displacement packed from the pack's _Displacement/_disp/_height map (matches matNormalArray .a convention read in terrain_lod_chunk.frag:274-276,827 and terrtxm2.cpp:2566-2571 cpuDispAlphaSize retention). albedo.ktx2 is BC7 sRGB RGBA, alpha unused (255).

rock.provenance: PolyHaven rocks_ground_02, 4K. Alpine bias: generic granite/scree rock face, matches alpine reference shots better than the 2K/6 variants.
rock.license: CC0 (PolyHaven convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

grass.provenance: AmbientCG Grass001, 2K. Short alpine-meadow-style grass blade texture -- reads well at mid/far LOD without a distracting flower pattern.
grass.license: CC0 (AmbientCG convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

dirt.provenance: PolyHaven dirt_aerial_03, 2K. Neutral packed-earth dirt, alpine trail color (not desert-red) -- best match among dirt_aerial_03/rocky_trail/ganges_river_pebbles for alpine reference shots.
dirt.license: CC0 (PolyHaven convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

concrete.provenance: AmbientCG Road004, 2K. Clean poured-concrete/road slab -- distinct from the already-hinted mat6/7/8 slots (painted_concrete_02/clean_asphalt/concrete_wall_003 per shaders/include/terrain_mat_layers.hglsl); this is the primary mat3 CONCRETE channel only. cracked_concrete_2k considered and rejected here (EXR-only rough/normal, no AO, and its damage pattern reads worse as a general splat base -- kept as an alternate for a future distressed variant).
concrete.license: CC0 (AmbientCG convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

snow.provenance: PolyHaven snow_field_aerial, 2K. Only snow candidate in the pack set; alpine wind-packed snow texture with visible sastrugi detail in the height map.
snow.license: CC0 (PolyHaven convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

cliff.mat_slot_hint: MAT_LAYER_MARBLE_CLIFF (5), already named in shaders/include/terrain_mat_layers.hglsl:10 -- this manifest just cooks the source, does not change the slot wiring.
cliff.provenance: PolyHaven marble_cliff_01, 2K. Already the intended mat5 triplanar cliff source per the existing shader comment; no height/displacement map shipped for this pack (cliff path uses triplanar sampling, not POM, per recon 3b/POM-synergy note) -- height left null.
cliff.license: CC0 (PolyHaven convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

shore_sand.provenance: PolyHaven aerial_beach_01, 2K. Only true sand/beach candidate in the pack set -- good direct match for a shoreline arc, no substitution needed.
shore_sand.license: CC0 (PolyHaven convention). No license file on disk in this download -- provenance assumed, not verified from an on-disk LICENSE.

wet_rock.mat_slot_hint: OPTIONAL -- shoreline arc, no MAT_LAYER_* slot allocated yet
wet_rock.provenance: NO GOOD MATCH FOUND. Best available candidate is dry_riverbed_rock (smooth water-tumbled river stone) -- geometry/shape reads close to a wet-rock shoreline but the pack is explicitly DRY (no wet-look darkening/specular baked in); ganges_river_pebbles considered as an alternate (also dry, smaller pebble scale). A true wet-rock/tide-pool AmbientCG or PolyHaven pack is NOT present anywhere under GameAsset and should be downloaded before shipping this channel for real.
